'''Guermessa''' was the secondary moon of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. From Tatooine's surface, it has an angular diameter of 26 arcminutes.

==Behind the scenes==
Guermessa is a village in Tunisia, where most of the Tatooine scenes were filmed.
